units.source_text: 逃脱失败后，男人变得非常谨慎。

en.t: After his failed escape, the man became extremely cautious.

units.source_text: 他打算像冬眠一样，顺应洞穴里的生活，他一心一意等待村里人警戒的解除。

en.t: He meant to adapt to life in the hole as if he were hibernating, and he waited single-mindedly for the villagers to let down their guard.

units.source_text: 俗话说，相同图形的反复，是有效的保护色。

en.t: As the saying goes, the repetition of the same pattern is an effective protective coloration.

units.source_text: 如果融化到生活的单纯反复之中，那么，

en.t: If he could dissolve into the simple repetition of daily life, then

units.source_text: 迟早他也就可以从村里人的意识里消失了，这并非没有可能。

en.t: sooner or later he might also disappear from the villagers' consciousness; it was not impossible.
